$comment: Mission 1.61 sections 3 to 8. Gate A7. The sentence Missions 1.57 to 1.60 said the documentation did not contain, and what it does and does not establish.
mission: 1.61 — Anchor Lineage Confirmation & Partner Documentation Recovery V1

two_exhaustiveness_questions_that_are_no.$comment: Section 3. Four missions have conflated these, and separating them is what makes the verdict readable.

LINEAGE_EXHAUSTIVENESS.question: Are the host-level service observations produced by the apparatus's own probes, and is any external measurement dataset load-bearing for the presence or absence of a service on a host?

SCAN_OR_FRAME_EXHAUSTIVENESS.question: Does the apparatus probe every address in its declared population, on every port of interest, in every cycle?
SCAN_OR_FRAME_EXHAUSTIVENESS.why_not: A different gate answering a different question. An apparatus can generate every one of its records by its own probing and still probe an incomplete frame. Conflating the two would let a lineage sentence be read as a coverage guarantee, which is exactly the overstatement this arc keeps refusing.

two_exhaustiveness_questions_that_are_no.the_distinction_that_must_survive: A7 asks WHO produced the observation. A5 asks WHICH addresses were reached. A LEVEL 2 lineage answer says nothing whatever about coverage, and this record must never be cited for coverage.

evidence_levels.$comment: Section 4. The ladder this arc has been climbing, written down so a later mission does not re-invent the rungs.
evidence_levels.LEVEL_0: No reference to third-party data anywhere in the documentation. An ABSENCE. Refused since Mission 1.57 as AFFIRMATIVE_LINEAGE_REQUIRED: an absence of a reference is an absence, not a statement.
evidence_levels.LEVEL_1: An affirmative first-party statement that the apparatus operates its own scanning infrastructure. Establishes that it probes; does not establish that nothing else feeds the load-bearing records.
evidence_levels.LEVEL_2: An affirmative first-party statement that the apparatus's records are produced by its own collection, with any external contributions ENUMERATED, such that a reader can check whether an enumerated exception touches the load-bearing predicate.

level_1_evidence.finding: The apparatus states that it uses its own scanning technology, purpose-built for large-scale internet scanning, and documents the address population, the port list and the transport protocols it scans.
level_1_evidence.what_it_establishes: The apparatus probes the network itself.
level_1_evidence.what_it_does_not_establish: That no external measurement dataset contributes to the records exposed by the search surface.

level_2_evidence.why_retrieved_twice: This is the single most load-bearing sentence in the mission, and the second retrieval asked for it verbatim rather than in summary, so the record quotes the document rather than a paraphrase of it.
level_2_evidence.verbatim_affirmative_statement: All the data is collected independently by Netlas itself. We do not rely on third parties or aggregators — every record is obtained and indexed directly by the platform.
level_2_evidence.verbatim_exception_clause: The only exceptions are the threat intelligence data shown in the IP/Domain Info tool and the geolocation data, which are provided by Netlas partners.
level_2_evidence.why_closed: The clause reads "the only exceptions" and then enumerates two named categories. That is an exhaustive statement with a stated remainder, not an open-ended list ending in "and other sources".

do_the_exceptions_touch_the_load_bearing.$comment: Section 6. The check that makes LEVEL 2 mean something. An enumerated exception is only harmless once somebody has looked at what it names.
do_the_exceptions_touch_the_load_bearing.load_bearing_predicate: a public IPv4 address accepted a TCP connection on port 22 and sent an identification string beginning with the literal prefix SSH- before negotiation

exceptions.name: threat intelligence data
exceptions.scope_as_documented: shown in the IP/Domain Info tool
exceptions.why: A reputation or threat annotation about an address is not the presence or absence of a service on it. Nothing in the predicate reads a threat label, and the predicate is decided from the bytes the peer sent.

exceptions.name: geolocation data
exceptions.why: Where an address is located is not whether it answered on a port. The construct counts distinct addresses and carries no geographic restriction, so no geolocation value enters the count.

do_the_exceptions_touch_the_load_bearing.conclusion: Neither enumerated exception is load-bearing for service presence. Both are enrichment ATTACHED TO a record rather than the source OF a record.
do_the_exceptions_touch_the_load_bearing.the_reasoning_that_was_refused: Mission 1.60 refused to infer exhaustiveness from a list of enrichment sources, because reading a positive claim out of a negative space is not evidence. What changed is not the reasoning, it is the document: the apparatus now states the positive claim itself, and the enrichment list is its own stated remainder rather than our inference from it.

gate_a7_verdict.basis: One first-party documentation page, retrieved twice, stating independent collection affirmatively and enumerating its only exceptions, neither of which bears on the load-bearing predicate.
gate_a7_verdict.what_this_closes: AFFIRMATIVE_LINEAGE_REQUIRED for this apparatus. The requirement was recorded in Mission 1.57 and has blocked four consecutive missions.
what_this_does_not_close: A5 frame exhaustiveness, which is a separate gate and stays PASS_WITH_STATED_BOUNDS
A8 operational reviewability, which is a separate gate and stays open
the vantage model, which the documentation does not describe
anything at all about the three partner candidates

bounds_on_this_finding.$comment: Section 7. What a reader must not take from this record.
bounds_on_this_finding.it_is_a_documentary_finding: The apparatus states this about itself in its own documentation. That is the strongest evidence class this arc admits, and it is a first-party assertion rather than an audit.
bounds_on_this_finding.it_is_not_an_independent_verification: Nobody outside the apparatus has verified that every record is self-collected, and this repository has no means to.
bounds_on_this_finding.it_is_not_a_reliability_value: A7 decides whether the apparatus is a measurement producer. How dependable its measurements are is a reliability review by a named person, and none has been performed.
bounds_on_this_finding.it_is_not_independence_from_a_partner: Independence is a two-sided property. A LEVEL 2 lineage answer from one side establishes that side's provenance and says nothing about whether a partner shares an upstream with it.

what_would_reopen_this.documentation_change: The apparatus widening its exception clause, or replacing 'the only exceptions' with an open-ended list.
what_would_reopen_this.an_enumerated_exception_reaching_the_pre: If a future exception named service-presence data, banner data or port-state data from a partner, A7 would reopen immediately and the verdict here would not survive it.
what_would_reopen_this.recheck_required_before: any threshold registration, because the lineage claim is what makes the two witnesses two measurements rather than two readings.
